Off Calendar Mar-25-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for Settlement Conference. Commissioner: Sue M. Kaplan, Clerk: P. Dias, Reporter: Loretta Najewra. Petitioner, Elisapeta Puletele Fonoti was sworn and examined. The Court grants decree changing Petitioner's name to Pelenise Krystle Faataui. Decree signed in open court.
